title: Charlie Marsh: uv: An Extremely Fast Python Package Manager
summary: Charlie Marsh of Astral explains how uv, a Rust Python package manager, got so fast. He covers allocators, concurrency, zero-copy tricks and the challenges of Python packaging.
why: Recommended as a fascinating technical account of the optimizations behind uv's speed.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: I recently watched a talk by the author of uv that was surprisingly fascinating
